scope: Static x500 collision-envelope audit, project config-to-EGO inflation parameter wiring, and targeted Jazzy build.
qualification: Preliminary GOAL F evidence only. No obstacle collision, clearance, planner response, trajectory tracking, PX4 control, or flight acceptance was tested; no quantitative acceptance threshold is frozen.

vehicle_collision_envelope.reference_frame: d435i_imu_frame, matching the child frame of /localization/optimized_imu_odom
vehicle_collision_envelope.calculation: Enumerated all eight corners of each supported SDF box collision; composed each link and collision pose; transformed points into the IMU frame using the d435i_mount joint and IMU sensor pose.
limitations: The D435i SDF contains no collision geometry for the camera housing or mount.
The x500 rotor collision boxes are static thin boxes and do not model the rotating propeller swept volume.
The result excludes map error, localization error, trajectory tracking error, data age, braking distance, and hardware variation.

planner_inflation.implementation: plan_env computes ceil(obstacles_inflation / resolution); the occupancy inflation helper marks index offsets from -step to +step on x, y, and z. The effective cell set is not a measured physical clearance.
planner_inflation.assessment: The current one-step occupancy dilation is smaller than the SDF collision-envelope radius around the actual EGO odometry body frame, before uncertainty or stopping margins. The value remains unchanged and PROVISIONAL pending calibration.

project_launch_paths: vio_closed_loop_ego_px4.launch.py resolves the selected planner JSON and passes obstacles_inflation to advanced_param.launch.py.
debug_truth_ego_px4.launch.py reads the same planner JSON and passes obstacles_inflation to advanced_param.launch.py.

isolated_ego_parameter_query.scope: EGO planner only; flight_type=2; no sensor publishers, trajectory server, PX4, controller, truth source, or vehicle control publisher; node remained INIT with no odometry.
